purpose: Quantify the source translation between the Massive RVOL the frozen E-MAX V1 was developed on and the Kiwoom-native RVOL the realtime runtime computes. One research axis only: the RVOL threshold.

frozen_and_not_under_study.ranking: R1 premarket_rvol DESC, ties by symbol ascending
frozen_and_not_under_study.reference_threshold: Massive RVOL >= 3.0 (E-MAX V1, not retroactively modified)

kiwoom_rvol_semantics.numerator: today pm_dollar_volume from Kiwoom minute bars in [04:00, 09:24] ET
kiwoom_rvol_semantics.denominator: rolling median of the prior staged sessions' pm_dollar_volume
kiwoom_rvol_semantics.mixing: forbidden; a Massive numerator with a Kiwoom denominator (or the reverse) is never computed

overlap_rule.membership: a row enters the comparison only when both the Massive development store and the Kiwoom historical store hold that symbol and session and both produce a finite RVOL
overlap_rule.reporting: overlap symbols, sessions and rows are reported, with the session range; a partial range is never described as a two-year validation
overlap_rule.leakage: each side's denominator uses only sessions strictly before the row's own session, as the frozen implementation does

acceptance_limits_declared_before_result.note: Every limit below must hold for the translation to be accepted. They are fixed here and are not adjusted to the outcome.

threshold_candidates.rule: derived from the distribution only, never from a return; no grid search

candidates.definition: the Kiwoom threshold whose pass rate over the overlap rows equals the Massive pass rate at 3.0 (quantile match)
3.0 scaled by the median of the per-row Kiwoom/Massive RVOL ratio, rounded to two decimals

threshold_candidates.forbidden: any enumeration such as 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 ..., and any candidate chosen by looking at performance

k1_authorization.condition: K1 runs only when K0 returns KIWOOM_RVOL_RECALIBRATION_REQUIRED
k1_authorization.data_sufficiency_first: before any performance number, the exact fields the Kiwoom store lacks are reported, with the minimum extra collection; re-collecting the whole history is forbidden
k1_authorization.hybrid_label: a Massive feature frame carrying a Kiwoom RVOL column is labelled SOURCE_TRANSLATION_DIAGNOSTIC and is never called a Kiwoom-native backtest

versioning.retain: STRATEGY_E_MAX_V1 and all its artifacts stay unchanged
versioning.on_threshold_change: preregister STRATEGY_E_MAX_V2_KIWOOM as a separate contract

paper_runtime.automatic_change: forbidden; the paper configuration is not touched until a V2 contract is separately approved
